name: fork-join

Setup.prompt:
Output exactly this topic, verbatim, no other text:

'Should deprecated CLI flags be removed in a major release, or kept for one more minor release?'

LeftBranch.prompt:
Argue for removing deprecated flags in the next major release. One sentence, no preamble.

Topic: ${Setup.output}

RightBranch.prompt:
Argue for keeping deprecated flags for one more minor release. One sentence, no preamble.

Topic: ${Setup.output}

graph:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Setup
    state fork_debate <<fork>>
    Setup --> fork_debate
    fork_debate --> LeftBranch
    fork_debate --> RightBranch
    state join_debate <<join>>
    LeftBranch --> join_debate
    RightBranch --> join_debate
    join_debate --> Summarize
    Summarize --> [*]
